title: Fluid grid + chart legend hitbox intermittently misaligned under pinch-to-zoom & RTL
creator: Marisol Ortega
description: On several internal dashboards we’ve observed that the chart legend interaction area (hitbox) and the adjacent compact grid/table rows shift out of alignment intermittently when users: 1) pinch-to-zoom on iOS Safari, 2) use RTL layouts, or 3) view in Firefox with CSS overflow auto and momentum scrolling. The visual misalignment is not purely cosmetic: it causes click targets to be inconsistent (legend toggles miss) and causes sticky headers in adjacent tables to snap unexpectedly when the viewport scale changes. This ticket scopes the design QA investigation, triage, and proposed fixes for the UI kit components involved (chart-legend, compact-grid, table-sticky-header).
acceptance_criteria: Repro steps produce deterministic reproduction notes for Safari iOS, Desktop Firefox, and an RTL locale (Arabic) in both pinch-zoom and non-zoomed scenarios
Design tokens associated with spacing and transforms are audited and a minimal set of token changes are proposed instead of component-level hardcoding
A prototype CSS/JS mitigation is implemented in the component playground that fixes hitbox misalignment across the three platforms without regressing a11y (focus outline/tab order preserved)
QA checklist added to UI kit docs with browser/viewport permutations and a test harness for visual regression runs
Pull request with code changes has design sign-off and a follow-up ENG ticket for runtime rollouts to Hosted and Dedicated variants
steps_to_reproduce: Open Dashboard > Sales Overview (use internal staging) on iPhone 13 / iOS 16.5 Safari with default zoom
Pinch-to-zoom in and out slowly while interacting with the chart legend (tap color chip to toggle series). Observe missed taps and legend chip shifting relative to series labels
Switch the app to RTL (Settings > Locale: ar) in the staging env. Resize viewport width to 360px and repeat taps on legend. Observe mirrored offset and occasionally duplicated focus rectangles

Open same dashboard in Desktop Firefox (latest ESR), enable momentum scroll on trackpad, and set browser zoom to 110%. Scroll the compact grid adjacent to the chart; observe sticky header snapping when chart reflows
Capture a desktop session replay and a Safari Web Inspector timeline while reproducing to correlate layout reflow events
notes: Preliminary triage notes and suggested approaches: 1) Likely cause is a mix of transform: translateZ / will-change on chart canvas combined with fractional device pixel ratios during pinch-zoom. Firefox treats overflow and scrolling differently which surfaces rounding errors that move sticky elements. 2) Prefer token-driven spacing fixes (spacing.token.inline, spacing.token.legend-hitbox) instead of ad-hoc pixel nudges. 3) Consider decoupling pointer hitboxes from visual elements by using pseudo-elements for the target area, sized using tokens and pointer-events optimizations. 4) Avoid using CSS transform for positioning interactive elements when possible — use top/left for elements participating in layout to keep sticky headers consistent. 5) If CSS-only fixes are insufficient, introduce a lightweight JS debounce that recalculates layout on zoom gesture end (limited to Safari iOS) and only when necessary to avoid perf regressions. 6) Document regression test cases in the UI kit playbook and include a cypress snapshot test for Firefox-specific overflow behavior.
